description: §38.10.3 — an `onclient:*` handler declared `server function` in the channel body fires E-CHANNEL-006. Before S461 no compiler source emitted the code: `onclient:open=onOpen(e)` with `server function onOpen(e)` compiled, and the browser listener called the fetch stub — a POST round-trip on every socket open.
rationale: §38.10.3: a function designated as the handler for an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL NOT be declared `server function`; the compiler SHALL emit E-CHANNEL-006 and reject the program.
